tiebreakers.description: Fewest loyalty swaps during the game.

notes: family: area-majority. Game ends after the Reveal Loyalty phase of round 4. Each empire scores cities controlled x your loyalty multiplier (Opposed is -1, so enter -1). Advanced rule: an agent a player placed on a region counts as a city for that player for the empire controlling that region, so add it to that empire's cities count for that player. Solo/other modes not modelled.
